biotools.summary: MSstatsWeightedSummary is an R package for relative quantification of proteins and post-translational modifications in proteomic experiments, particularly addressing shared peptides. It implements a statistical approach to estimate abundances and site occupancies from quantitative information derived from shared peptides.
